title: [Master] - Slice 640938: [Expense Agent][VENDOR] Adding approval limits (November '26)
summary: The Expense Agent now supports approval limits for vendors, allowing managers to configure spending thresholds in user setup and enabling automatic approval workflow routing based on expense amounts.
key_points: Added approval limit fields to User Setup and Expense User tables for vendor-based approval configuration
Enhanced approval management logic to evaluate and route expenses based on configured spending limits
Updated manager and user-facing pages to display and manage approval limits
Added upgrade logic to initialize approval setup for existing systems
Expanded test coverage with new approval scenario tests for limit-based workflows
